name: Optimus One

images.credit: GillyBerlin, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM/GPRS/EDGE Quad-band (850/900/1800/1900) , UMTS/HSPA tri-band (900/1700/2100) , HSDPA 7.2 Mbit/s , GPRS Class 10 (4+1/3+2 slots), 32-48 kbit/s , CDMA EVDO Rev. A (800/1900-Global, 1800-Korea LG U+ Variant Korean Pcs)

Body.Dimensions: 113.5 mm H , 59 mm W , 13.3 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android Froyo, Android 2.2.1 "Froyo", Current: Android Gingerbread, Android 2.3.3 "Gingerbread"
Platform.CPU: Qualcomm 600 MHz ARM1136EJ-S , GSM MSM7227 , CDMA MSM7627

Memory.Storage: 512 MB flash EEPROM (140 or 170 MB user addressable)
Memory.Card slot: 2 GB microSD (supports up to 32 GB, with the exception of Optimus T)

Display.Display: TFT LCD, 3.2 in diagonal , 320×480px HVGA @ 180ppi, 2:3 aspect-ratio wide-screen , 256K colors

Cameras.Rear camera: VGA video recording (640×480 px, MPEG4 at 18 fps max.), Auto-focus , Europe and Asia 3-megapixels , United States and Canada 3.15 megapixels (2048×1536 px max.)

Battery.Battery: LGIP-400N , 1,500 mAh, 5.6 Wh, 3.7 V , Internal Rechargeable Li-ion , User replaceable

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm audio jack , Bluetooth 2.1 + EDR with A2DP , FM stereo receiver (87.5-108 MHz) with RDS (certain variants) , Micro USB 2.0 , Wi-Fi 802.11b/g
